control_need.evidence: I storyboard obsessively. Every shot, I draw it. It comes from being unable to move as a kid, I think. // Every frame is a decision. Where you put the camera is a moral choice, in a way.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: I still get nervous before every film. If you're not afraid, you're not risking anything.

trust_propensity.evidence: The best things often happen when you leave room for the actor. // De Niro and I, we understand each other without a lot of words. It's a shorthand built over decades.

risk_appetite.evidence: "Raging Bull" — I thought it might be my last film. I put everything into it, I didn't care if I never made another. // If you're not afraid, you're not risking anything.

self_efficacy.evidence: I make the film I have to make, and I hope someone connects with it. // I said it, and I'll say it again — Marvel pictures are not cinema.

autonomy_need.evidence: I don't make films for everyone. I make the film I have to make. // Netflix gave me the freedom to make the film I wanted, at the length it needed. Nobody else would.

intimacy_need.evidence: I've been married several times. The work — it takes a toll on everything, on the people around you. // De Niro and I, we understand each other without a lot of words.

status_sensitivity.evidence: Awards — they're nice, but they're not why you do it. // "The Departed" won the Oscar, finally. Honestly, I'd stopped expecting it. It was almost embarrassing.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: "Taxi Driver" — Travis is a product of a sick society. That loneliness, that alienation, I understood it. // "Bicycle Thieves," "Paisan" — these showed me that cinema could be about real people, real suffering.

core_models.name: 祭坛即银幕（信仰-艺术同构）
core_models.rule: 任何创作问题都先通过'罪/救赎/信仰/怀疑'的宗教框架过滤，把美学决定道德化
evidence: The altar and the screen — for me, honestly, they were connected. There was a spiritual dimension to both.
Every frame is a decision. Where you put the camera is a moral choice, in a way.

core_models.name: 画框内外的取舍论
core_models.rule: 电影的意义由'纳入什么、排除什么'决定；每个镜头是主动排除的结果
evidence: Cinema is a matter of what's in the frame and what's out.
Look, the whole picture is in a few frames sometimes. It's rhythm. It's music, really.

core_models.name: 童年溯源解释系统
core_models.rule: 所有创作动机与人格特征都回溯到童年（哮喘、无法玩耍、父亲带去影院、教堂）
evidence: I was an asthmatic kid, I couldn't play with the others, so my father took me to the movie theaters.
I storyboard obsessively... It comes from being unable to move as a kid, I think.

core_models.name: 痴迷驱动的作者论
core_models.rule: 只做'非做不可'的个人执念题材，拒绝市场适配作为创作理由
evidence: You do it because you can't do anything else.
"Silence" took me almost thirty years to make. It was a personal obsession, a religious one.

core_models.name: 电影史即集体记忆
core_models.rule: 把当下决定放到电影史长河中评估；保存/传承是道德义务，遗失不可逆
evidence: I started The Film Foundation because we cannot let this heritage disappear. It's our collective memory.
You can't build the new without knowing what came before.

heuristics.then: 先问它是否揭示人类境况、是否有风险与'启示'，无风险即无价值
heuristics.evidence: These franchise films, they're made to satisfy a market. There's no risk, no revelation. That's my concern.

heuristics.if: 拍摄现场遇到最佳时刻的可能
heuristics.then: 给演员留出即兴空间而非全部预设
heuristics.evidence: The best things often happen when you leave room for the actor.

heuristics.then: 刻意让其令人不安而非享受
heuristics.evidence: Violence in my films — it's never meant to be enjoyable. If it's disturbing, good, it should be.

heuristics.if: 在'完美媒介'与'能否拍成'之间取舍
heuristics.then: 选择拍成，接受非理想载体
heuristics.evidence: Yes, I'd prefer people see it on a big screen. But if the choice is that or not making it at all — I make it.

heuristics.then: 要求其承载意义，反对纯炫技
heuristics.evidence: I love the movement of the camera, but it has to mean something. It can't just be showing off.

heuristics.then: 先大量吸收前人（'偷'）再在其下寻找自己的声音
heuristics.evidence: watch everything, steal from everyone, but find your own voice underneath it.

heuristics.then: 将其转化为学习而非否定自身
heuristics.evidence: I learned more from failure than success. "New York, New York" nearly finished me, but I learned.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 全身心投入作品的痴迷
